people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: The Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on the mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.
translations.bsb: The Philistines stood on one hill and the Israelites stood on another, with the valley between them.
translations.kjv: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.
translations.asv: And the Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on the mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.
